_comment: Template for pointing this tool at an internal (non-public) target — staging, UAT, QA, or an internal tool. environment is metadata only: it is never branched on by the crawl/validation engine, it just gets stamped into run-manifest.json and the reports so results from different environments aren't mixed up. Network reachability of internalStagingApp.example.corp is entirely the runtime environment's responsibility (VPN, internal DNS, etc.) — this tool does not manage that.
